The binary digits repeat with block \(1001\), so the sequence \(\{a_n\}\) has period \(4\):

\[
a_1=\frac35,\quad a_2=\frac15,\quad a_3=\frac25,\quad a_4=\frac45,
\]
and then repeats.

Each period sums to
\[
\frac35+\frac15+\frac25+\frac45=2.
\]
Since
\[
2016=4\cdot 504,
\]
we have
\[
S_{2016}=504\cdot 2=1008.
\]

\[
\boxed{1008}
\]
